posts.hook: AI labs keep raising billions while Wall Street flinches
posts.caption: thinking machines unveiled inkling 2 small and is raising $5b, investors doubt anthropic's ipo can reach $1.5t, openai dropped data center ndas with public officials. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Thinking Machines debuts Inkling 2 Small, a 594B MoE with weights due next week
slides.desc: Proprietary first; rated top open model outside China once weights ship, per Artificial Analysis.

terms.gloss: a model that sends each token to a few specialist sub-networks

slides.title: Investors doubt Anthropic's IPO can reach $1.5T after the selloff
slides.desc: One says closer to ==$1T==, per WSJ sources.

slides.title: OpenAI drops NDAs with public officials on data center projects
slides.desc: Secrecy was a flashpoint; this is the first company answer to the midterm vote.

slides.title: Perplexity launches Teammates, always-on agents that hold several jobs at once
slides.desc: Joins OpenAI's Dots and Claude Duet in the race for standing coworkers.

slides.title: The sshole bug lets attackers log into some Alpine Linux boxes without a password
slides.desc: A decade-old flaw between OpenSSH and musl, but it needs a very specific setup.

terms.gloss: a lightweight C library that Alpine Linux uses

slides.title: The New York Times is in exclusive talks to buy Letterboxd for about $330M
slides.desc: Founders would stay and the site would remain standalone, per the NYT.

posts.hook: The midterm hangover hits Nvidia, Apple and TikTok
posts.caption: democrats are lining up oversight of nvidia, apple and meta, the eu preliminarily found tiktok's feed breaches the dsa, tesla is ending the cybertruck in 2027. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Democrats step up oversight of Nvidia over chip exports and circular financing
slides.desc: Huang is also asked to brief Congress behind closed doors on ==November 18==.

terms.gloss: a company funding customers who then spend that money on its products

slides.title: Democrats eye Apple, Meta and Musk-led companies as early investigation targets
slides.desc: Executives who courted the president are scrambling, per the Washington Post.

slides.title: EU says TikTok's feed breaches the DSA by trapping users in harmful rabbit holes
slides.desc: A preliminary finding from the Commission, not a fine yet.

terms.gloss: the EU law that makes big platforms manage harms from their feeds

slides.title: Tesla will stop building the Cybertruck in mid-2027
slides.desc: The factory space likely goes to the Cybercab, per Ars Technica.

slides.title: DOJ indicts three over AI impersonation of CEOs and law firm attorneys
slides.desc: Alleged fraud of ==$129M or more==; a familiar voice is no longer proof of identity.

slides.desc: It now controls a platform reaching over 100 million US households.
